rationale: PR #315 proved that persisted governed education publications had no typed repository/index or generic lookup boundary. This extension reconstructs and validates EducationPublicationRecord JSON, rejects duplicate concept publications, reuses governed concept mention resolution, and re-checks CUSTOMER_EDUCATION admission before returning education to orchestration.
authority_impact: No new authority is introduced. The existing education publication contract and admission decision remain authoritative; the repository only loads, indexes, and selects already-authorized education records.
